754DECLARE_DELEGATE_ThreeParams(FLoadPackageAsyncDelegate, const FName& /*PackageName*/, UPackage* /*LoadedPackage*/, EAsyncLoadingResult::Type /*Result*/)
755
756
759struct FLoadPackageAsyncProgressParams
760{
761 /* Name of the package. */
762 const FName PackageName { NAME_None };
763 /* Pointer to UPackage being loaded, can be nullptr depending on async loading progress. */
764 const UPackage* LoadedPackage { nullptr };
765 /* Progress of async loading. */
766 const EAsyncLoadingProgress ProgressType { EAsyncLoadingProgress::Failed };
767};
768
772class FLoadPackageAsyncProgressDelegate
773{
774public:
775 using DelegateType = TTSDelegate<void(FLoadPackageAsyncProgressParams& Params)>;
776
777 FLoadPackageAsyncProgressDelegate(DelegateType&& InDelegate, uint32 InMask = MAX_uint32)
778 : Delegate(Forward<DelegateType>(InDelegate))
779 , Mask(InMask)
780 {}
781
782 constexpr static inline uint32 BuildMask(EAsyncLoadingProgress Progress)
783 {
784 return 1 << (uint32)Progress;
785 }
786
787 constexpr static inline uint32 BuildMask(auto... Types)
788 {
789 return (0 | ... | BuildMask(Types));
790 }
791
792 void Invoke(FLoadPackageAsyncProgressParams& Params)
793 {
794 if (Mask & BuildMask(Params.ProgressType))
795 {
796 Delegate.ExecuteIfBound(Params);
797 }
798 }
799
800private:
801 TTSDelegate<void(FLoadPackageAsyncProgressParams& Params)> Delegate;
802 const uint32 Mask { MAX_uint32 };
803};

1657
1659 int32 Find(FName InComponentName) const
1660 {
1661 for (int32 Index = 0 ; Index < Overrides.Num(); Index++)
1662 {
1663 if (Overrides[Index].ComponentName == InComponentName)
1664 {
1665 return Index;
1666 }
1667 }
1668 return INDEX_NONE;
1669 }
1671 struct FOverride
1672 {
1673 FName ComponentName;
1674 const UClass* ComponentClass = nullptr;
1675 TUniquePtr<FOverrides> SubOverrides;
1676 bool bDoNotCreate = false;
1677 FOverride(FName InComponentName)
1678 : ComponentName(InComponentName)
1679 {
1680 }
1681
1682 FOverride& operator=(const FOverride& Other)
1683 {
1684 ComponentName = Other.ComponentName;
1685 ComponentClass = Other.ComponentClass;
1686 SubOverrides = (Other.SubOverrides ? MakeUnique<FOverrides>(*Other.SubOverrides) : nullptr);
1687 bDoNotCreate = Other.bDoNotCreate;
1688 return *this;
1689 }
1690
1691 FOverride(const FOverride& Other)
1692 {
1693 *this = Other;
1694 }
1695
1696 FOverride(FOverride&&) = default;
1697 FOverride& operator=(FOverride&&) = default;
1698 };
1700 TArray<FOverride, TInlineAllocator<8> > Overrides;
1701 };
1703 struct FSubobjectsToInit
1704 {

1707 {
1708 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < SubobjectInits.Num(); Index++)
1709 {
1710 check(SubobjectInits[Index].Subobject != Subobject);
1711 }
1712 SubobjectInits.Emplace(Subobject, Template);
1713 }

1716 {
1717 UObject* Subobject;
1718 UObject* Template;
1719 FSubobjectInit(UObject* InSubobject, UObject* InTemplate)
1720 : Subobject(InSubobject)
1721 , Template(InTemplate)
1722 {
1723 }
1724 };
1725
1726 TArray<FSubobjectInit, TInlineAllocator<8> > SubobjectInits;
1727 };

1929template< class T >
1930FUNCTION_NON_NULL_RETURN_START
1931 T* NewObject(UObject* Outer, const UClass* Class, FName Name = NAME_None, EObjectFlags Flags = RF_NoFlags, UObject* Template = nullptr, bool bCopyTransientsFromClassDefaults = false, FObjectInstancingGraph* InInstanceGraph = nullptr, UPackage* InExternalPackage = nullptr)
1932FUNCTION_NON_NULL_RETURN_END
1933{
1934 if (Name == NAME_None)
1935 {
1936 FObjectInitializer::AssertIfInConstructor(Outer, TEXT("NewObject with empty name can't be used to create default subobjects (inside of UObject derived class constructor) as it produces inconsistent object names. Use ObjectInitializer.CreateDefaultSubobject<> instead."));
1937 }
1938
1939#if DO_CHECK
1940 // Class was specified explicitly, so needs to be validated
1941 CheckIsClassChildOf_Internal(T::StaticClass(), Class);
1942#endif
1943
1944 FStaticConstructObjectParameters Params(Class);
1945 Params.Outer = Outer;
1946 Params.Name = Name;
1947 Params.SetFlags = Flags;
1948 Params.Template = Template;
1949 Params.bCopyTransientsFromClassDefaults = bCopyTransientsFromClassDefaults;
1950 Params.InstanceGraph = InInstanceGraph;
1951 Params.ExternalPackage = InExternalPackage;
1952
1953 T* Result = static_cast<T*>(StaticConstructObject_Internal(Params));
1954 return Result;
1955}
1956
1957template< class T >
1958FUNCTION_NON_NULL_RETURN_START
1959 T* NewObject(UObject* Outer = GetTransientPackageAsObject())
1960FUNCTION_NON_NULL_RETURN_END
1961{
1962 // Name is always None for this case
1963 FObjectInitializer::AssertIfInConstructor(Outer, TEXT("NewObject with empty name can't be used to create default subobjects (inside of UObject derived class constructor) as it produces inconsistent object names. Use ObjectInitializer.CreateDefaultSubobject<> instead."));
1964
1965 FStaticConstructObjectParameters Params(T::StaticClass());
1966 Params.Outer = Outer;
1967
1968 T* Result = static_cast<T*>(StaticConstructObject_Internal(Params));
1969 return Result;
1970}
1971
1972template< class T >
1973FUNCTION_NON_NULL_RETURN_START
1974 T* NewObject(UObject* Outer, FName Name, EObjectFlags Flags = RF_NoFlags, UObject* Template = nullptr, bool bCopyTransientsFromClassDefaults = false, FObjectInstancingGraph* InInstanceGraph = nullptr, UPackage* InExternalPackage = nullptr)
1975FUNCTION_NON_NULL_RETURN_END
1976{
1977 if (Name == NAME_None)
1978 {
1979 FObjectInitializer::AssertIfInConstructor(Outer, TEXT("NewObject with empty name can't be used to create default subobjects (inside of UObject derived class constructor) as it produces inconsistent object names. Use ObjectInitializer.CreateDefaultSubobject<> instead."));
1980 }
1981
1982 FStaticConstructObjectParameters Params(T::StaticClass());
1983 Params.Outer = Outer;
1984 Params.Name = Name;
1985 Params.SetFlags = Flags;
1986 Params.Template = Template;
1987 Params.bCopyTransientsFromClassDefaults = bCopyTransientsFromClassDefaults;
1988 Params.InstanceGraph = InInstanceGraph;

1990

2238template <class T>
2239bool ContainsObjectOfClass( const TArray<T*>& ObjectArray, UClass* ClassToCheck, EFindObjectFlags Flags = EFindObjectFlags::None, TArray<T*>* out_Objects=nullptr )
2240{
2241 bool bResult = false;
2242 for ( int32 ArrayIndex = 0; ArrayIndex < ObjectArray.Num(); ArrayIndex++ )
2243 {
2244 if ( ObjectArray[ArrayIndex] != nullptr )
2245 {
2246 bool bMatchesSearchCriteria = !!(Flags & EFindObjectFlags::ExactClass)
2247 ? ObjectArray[ArrayIndex]->GetClass() == ClassToCheck
2248 : ObjectArray[ArrayIndex]->IsA(ClassToCheck);
2249
2250 if ( bMatchesSearchCriteria )
2251 {
2252 bResult = true;
2253 if ( out_Objects != nullptr )
2254 {
2255 out_Objects->Add(ObjectArray[ArrayIndex]);
2256 }
2257 else
2258 {
2259 // if we don't need a list of objects that match the search criteria, we can stop as soon as we find at least one object of that class
2260 break;
2261 }
2262 }
2263 }
2264 }
2265
2266 return bResult;
2267}

2269UE_EXACTCLASS_BOOL_DEPRECATED("ContainsObjectOfClass")
2270UE_NODEBUG UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool ContainsObjectOfClass( const TArray<T*>& ObjectArray, UClass* ClassToCheck, ExactClassType bExactClass, TArray<T*>* out_Objects=nullptr )
2271{
2272 return ContainsObjectOfClass(ObjectArray, ClassToCheck, bExactClass ? EFindObjectFlags::ExactClass : EFindObjectFlags::None, out_Objects );
2273}

2330class TObjectArrayIterator
2331{
2332 /* sample code
2333 TArray<APawn *> TestPawns;
2334 ...
2335 // test iterator, all items
2336 for ( TObjectArrayIterator<APawn> It(TestPawns); It; ++It )
2337 {
2338 UE_LOGF(LogUObjectGlobals, Log, "Item %ls",*It->GetFullName());
2339 }
2340 */
2341public:
2348 inline TObjectArrayIterator( TArray<TObjectClass*>& InArray, UClass* InClassToCheck = nullptr, EFindObjectFlags InFlags = EFindObjectFlags::None) :
2349 Array(InArray),
2350 Index(-1),
2351 ClassToCheck(InClassToCheck),
2352 Flags(InFlags)
2353 {
2354 Advance();
2355 }
2356 template <UE::CSameAs<bool> ExactClassType>
2357 UE_EXACTCLASS_BOOL_DEPRECATED("TObjectArrayIterator")
2358 UE_NODEBUG UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TObjectArrayIterator( TArray<TObjectClass*>& InArray, UClass* InClassToCheck, ExactClassType bInExactClass)
2359 : TObjectArrayIterator(InArray, InClassToCheck, bInExactClass ? EFindObjectFlags::ExactClass : EFindObjectFlags::None)
2360 {
2361 }
2362
2365 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void operator++()
2366 {
2367 Advance();
2368 }
2369
2370 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT explicit operator bool() const
2371 {
2372 return Index < Array.Num();
2373 }
2374
2375 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool operator !() const
2376 {
2377 return !(bool)*this;
2378 }
2379
2384 inline TObjectClass& operator*() const
2385 {
2386 checkSlow(GetObject());
2387 return *GetObject();
2388 }
2389
2393 inline TObjectClass* operator->() const
2394 {
2395 checkSlow(GetObject());
2396 return GetObject();
2397 }
2398
2403 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void RemoveCurrent()
2404 {
2405 Array.RemoveAt(Index--);
2406 }
2407
2411 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void RemoveCurrentSwap()
2412 {
2413 Array.RemoveSwap(Index--);
2414 }
2415
2416protected:
2421 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TObjectClass* GetObject() const
2422 {
2423 return Array(Index);
2424 }
2425
2429 inline bool Advance()
2430 {
2431 while(++Index < Array.Num())
2432 {
2433 TObjectClass* At = GetObject();
2434 if (
2435 IsValid(At) &&
2436 (!ClassToCheck ||
2437 (!!(Flags & EFindObjectFlags::ExactClass)
2438 ? At->GetClass() == ClassToCheck
2439 : At->IsA(ClassToCheck)))
2440 )
2441 {
2442 return true;
2443 }
2444 }
2445 return false;
2446 }
2447private:
2449 TArray<TObjectClass*>& Array;
2451 int32 Index;
2453 UClass* ClassToCheck;
2455 EFindObjectFlags Flags;
2456};

2545 template <typename KeyType, typename ValueType, typename Allocator, typename KeyFuncs>
2546 inline void AddStableReferenceMap(TMapBase<KeyType, ValueType, Allocator, KeyFuncs>& Map)
2547 {
2548#if UE_REFERENCE_COLLECTOR_REQUIRE_OBJECTPTR
2549 static constexpr bool bKeyReference = TIsTObjectPtr<KeyType>::Value;
2550 static constexpr bool bValueReference = TIsTObjectPtr<ValueType>::Value;
2551 static_assert(bKeyReference || bValueReference);
2552 static_assert(!(std::is_pointer_v<KeyType> && std::is_convertible_v<KeyType, const UObjectBase*>));
2553 static_assert(!(std::is_pointer_v<ValueType> && std::is_convertible_v<ValueType, const UObjectBase*>));
2554#else
2555 static constexpr bool bKeyReference = std::is_convertible_v<KeyType, const UObjectBase*>;
2556 static constexpr bool bValueReference = std::is_convertible_v<ValueType, const UObjectBase*>;
2557 static_assert(bKeyReference || bValueReference, "Key or value must be pointer to fully-defined UObject type");
2558#endif
2559
2560 for (TPair<KeyType, ValueType>& Pair : Map)
2561 {
2562 if constexpr (bKeyReference)
2563 {
2564 AddStableReference(&Pair.Key);
2565 }
2566 if constexpr (bValueReference)
2567 {
2568 AddStableReference(&Pair.Value);
2569 }
2570 }
2571 }

2885 {
2886 HandleObjectReference(*reinterpret_cast<UObject**>(&It.Key), ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);
2887 }
2888 if (IsObjectHandleResolved_ForGC(It.Value.GetHandle()))
2889 {
2890 HandleObjectReference(*reinterpret_cast<UObject**>(&It.Value), ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);
2891 }
2892 }
2893 }

3027 const UObject* ReferencingObject = nullptr,

3029 {

3042 template<class UObjectType>
3043 static void AddReferencedObjects(FReferenceCollector& Coll,
3044 TArray<const UObjectType*>& ObjectArray,
3045 const UObject* ReferencingObject = nullptr,
3046 const FProperty* ReferencingProperty = nullptr)
3047 {
3048 static_assert(sizeof(UObjectType) > 0, "AddReferencedObjects: Elements must be pointers to a fully-defined type");
3049 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<UObjectType, const UObjectBase>::Value, "AddReferencedObjects: Elements must be pointers to a type derived from UObject");
3050 Coll.HandleObjectReferences(reinterpret_cast<UObject**>(const_cast<UObjectType**>(ObjectArray.GetData())), ObjectArray.Num(), ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);

3054 static void AddReferencedObjects(FReferenceCollector& Coll,

3057 const FProperty* ReferencingProperty = nullptr)
3058 {

3060 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<UObjectType, const UObjectBase>::Value, "AddReferencedObjects: Elements must be pointers to a type derived from UObject");
3061 for (auto& Object : ObjectSet)

3067 template <typename KeyType, typename ValueType, typename Allocator, typename KeyFuncs>
3068 static void AddReferencedObjects(FReferenceCollector& Coll,
3069 TMapBase<KeyType*, ValueType, Allocator, KeyFuncs>& Map,
3070 const UObject* ReferencingObject = nullptr,
3071 const FProperty* ReferencingProperty = nullptr)
3072 {
3073 static_assert(sizeof(KeyType) > 0, "AddReferencedObjects: Keys must be pointers to a fully-defined type");
3074 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<KeyType, const UObjectBase>::Value, "AddReferencedObjects: Keys must be pointers to a type derived from UObject");
3075 for (auto& It : Map)
3076 {
3077 Coll.HandleObjectReference(*(UObject**)&It.Key, ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);
3078 }

3081 template <typename KeyType, typename ValueType, typename Allocator, typename KeyFuncs>
3082 static void AddReferencedObjects(FReferenceCollector& Coll,
3083 TMapBase<KeyType, ValueType*, Allocator, KeyFuncs>& Map,
3084 const UObject* ReferencingObject = nullptr,
3085 const FProperty* ReferencingProperty = nullptr)
3086 {
3087 static_assert(sizeof(ValueType) > 0, "AddReferencedObjects: Values must be pointers to a fully-defined type");
3088 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<ValueType, const UObjectBase>::Value, "AddReferencedObjects: Values must be pointers to a type derived from UObject");
3089 for (auto& It : Map)
3090 {
3091 Coll.HandleObjectReference(*(UObject**)&It.Value, ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);
3092 }
3093 }
3094
3095 template <typename KeyType, typename ValueType, typename Allocator, typename KeyFuncs>
3096 static void AddReferencedObjects(FReferenceCollector& Coll, TMapBase<KeyType*, ValueType*, Allocator, KeyFuncs>& Map, const UObject* ReferencingObject = nullptr, const FProperty* ReferencingProperty = nullptr)
3097 {
3098 static_assert(sizeof(KeyType) > 0, "AddReferencedObjects: Keys must be pointers to a fully-defined type");
3099 static_assert(sizeof(ValueType) > 0, "AddReferencedObjects: Values must be pointers to a fully-defined type");
3100 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<KeyType, const UObjectBase>::Value, "AddReferencedObjects: Keys must be pointers to a type derived from UObject");
3101 static_assert(TPointerIsConvertibleFromTo<ValueType, const UObjectBase>::Value, "AddReferencedObjects: Values must be pointers to a type derived from UObject");
3102 for (auto& It : Map)
3103 {
3104 Coll.HandleObjectReference(*(UObject**)&It.Key, ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);
3105 Coll.HandleObjectReference(*(UObject**)&It.Value, ReferencingObject, ReferencingProperty);
3106 }
3107 }
3108
3109 static void AddReferencedObjects(FReferenceCollector& Coll,
3110 const UScriptStruct*& ScriptStruct,
3111 void* Instance, const UObject* ReferencingObject = nullptr, const FProperty* ReferencingProperty = nullptr);
3112 };

3114protected:
3122 virtual void HandleObjectReference(UObject*& InObject, const UObject* InReferencingObject, const FProperty* InReferencingProperty) = 0;
3123
3132 virtual void HandleObjectReferences(UObject** InObjects, const int32 ObjectNum, const UObject* InReferencingObject, const FProperty* InReferencingProperty)
3133 {
3134 for (int32 ObjectIndex = 0; ObjectIndex < ObjectNum; ++ObjectIndex)
3135 {
3136 UObject*& Object = InObjects[ObjectIndex];
3137 HandleObjectReference(Object, InReferencingObject, InReferencingProperty);
3138 }
3139 }

3270enum class ECompiledInUObjectsRegisteredStatus
3271{
3272
3273 // Registration for the given module has been delayed and will be registered with a layer notification where the package name is NAME_None.
3274 // Calls to FindObject<> for any delayed registrations will return nullptr.
3275 Delayed,
3276
3277 // All pending registrations have been done but CDOs have not been created. This may be invoked multiple times for the same package name.
3278 // Calls to FindObject<> for all pending registrations will return the UObject in question.
3279 PreCDO,
3280
3281 // All pending registrations and CDO creation has been done. Calls to FindObject<> for all pending registrations will return the UObject
3282 // in question. The CDO will also be available for any registered UClasses.
3283 PostCDO,
3284};

3607 #define UE_ASSET_LOG(CategoryName, Verbosity, Asset, Format, ...) \
3608 { \
3609 static_assert(TIsArrayOrRefOfTypeByPredicate<decltype(Format), TIsCharEncodingCompatibleWithTCHAR>::Value, "Formatting string must be a TCHAR array."); \
3610 static_assert((ELogVerbosity::Verbosity & ELogVerbosity::VerbosityMask) < ELogVerbosity::NumVerbosity && ELogVerbosity::Verbosity > 0, "Verbosity must be constant and in range."); \
3611 CA_CONSTANT_IF((ELogVerbosity::Verbosity & ELogVerbosity::VerbosityMask) <= ELogVerbosity::COMPILED_IN_MINIMUM_VERBOSITY && (ELogVerbosity::Warning & ELogVerbosity::VerbosityMask) <= FLogCategory##CategoryName::CompileTimeVerbosity) \
3612 { \
3613 UE_LOG_EXPAND_IS_FATAL(Verbosity, UE_EMPTY, if (!CategoryName.IsSuppressed(ELogVerbosity::Verbosity))) \
3614 { \
3615 ::UE::Core::Private::RecordAssetLog(CategoryName.GetCategoryName(), ELogVerbosity::Verbosity, ::UE::FAssetLog(Asset), FString::Printf(Format, ##__VA_ARGS__), __FILE__, __LINE__); \
3616 UE_LOG_EXPAND_IS_FATAL(Verbosity, \
3617 { \
3618 UE_DEBUG_BREAK_AND_PROMPT_FOR_REMOTE(); \
3619 FDebug::AssertFailed("", __FILE__, __LINE__, TEXT("%s: %s"), *FAssetMsg::FormatPathForAssetLog(Asset), *FString::Printf(Format, ##__VA_ARGS__)); \
3620 CA_ASSUME(false); \
3621 }, \
3622 UE_EMPTY \
3623 ) \
3624 } \
3625 } \
3626 }
3627#endif // NO_LOGGING

4165 // Parameter wrapper for FField* or UObject* which can be used as a parameter in a constexpr context
4166 // FFieldOwner cannot be used directly because we can't use the tagged pointer/union code in constexpr
4167 struct FFieldOwnerParam
4168 {
4169 union FValue
4170 {
4171 UObject* Object;
4172 FField* Field;
4173 } Value;
4174 bool bIsObject;
4175
4176 constexpr FFieldOwnerParam()
4177 {
4178 Value.Object = nullptr;
4179 bIsObject = true;
4180 }
4181 // Implicit construction from UObject*
4182 constexpr FFieldOwnerParam(UObject* InObject)
4183 {
4184 Value.Object = InObject;
4185 bIsObject = true;
4186 }
4187 // Implicit construction from FField*
4188 constexpr FFieldOwnerParam(FField* InField)
4189 {
4190 Value.Field = InField;
4191 bIsObject = false;
4192 }
4193 };
4194
4195 // Parameter wrapper for either an object pointer or an encoded reference to an object in another module to be linked
4196 // TCompiledInObjectPtr cannot be used directly because we can't use the tagged pointer/union code in constexpr
4197 template<typename T>
4198 struct TObjectRefParam
4199 {
4200 T* ObjectPtr = nullptr;
4201#if !IS_MONOLITHIC
4202 FCompiledInObjectPtr CompiledInPtr;
4203#endif // !IS_MONOLITHIC
4204
4205 constexpr TObjectRefParam() = default;
4206 constexpr TObjectRefParam(const TObjectRefParam&) = default;
4207 constexpr TObjectRefParam& operator=(const TObjectRefParam&) = default;
4208
4209 // These constructors are not explicit to simplify UHT generated code
4210 constexpr TObjectRefParam(T* InPtr)
4211 : ObjectPtr(InPtr)
4212 {
4213 }
4214
4215#if IS_MONOLITHIC
4216 constexpr bool IsUnset() const
4217 {
4218 return ObjectPtr == nullptr;
4219 }
4220#else // IS_MONOLITHIC
4221 constexpr TObjectRefParam(uint32 InModuleId, uint32 InObjectId)
4222 : CompiledInPtr(FCompiledInObjectReference{InModuleId, InObjectId})
4223 {
4224 }
4225
4226 constexpr TObjectRefParam(FCompiledInObjectReference InRef)
4227 : CompiledInPtr(InRef)
4228 {
4229 }
4230 constexpr bool IsUnset() const
4231 {
4232 return ObjectPtr == nullptr && CompiledInPtr.IsUnset();
4233 }
4234#endif // IS_MONOLITHIC
4235
4236 constexpr explicit operator bool() const
4237 {
4238 return !IsUnset();
4239 }
4240
4241 constexpr bool operator==(TYPE_OF_NULLPTR)
4242 {
4243 return IsUnset();
4244 }
4245
4246 constexpr bool operator!=(TYPE_OF_NULLPTR)
4247 {
4248 return !IsUnset();
4249 }
4250 };
4251
4252 using FObjectRefParam = TObjectRefParam<UObject>;
